Root cause of the bulk of the remaining ~76 --ops clusters is now clearer: most trace downstream of the SAME already-parked entry-region register/frame difference (stmw r16 vs r17, frame 648 vs 632, double p->index load) via accumulated instruction-offset drift, not independently reachable declaration-order bugs — confirmed by re-deriving several clusters' true source location via the paired T[]/O[] instruction-index correspondence in --ops output rather than naive same-byte-offset comparison (naive comparison across a drifted region silently points at the wrong source line; always use the paired indices).
